dispute_ticket.description: The driver stopped for a long time at a food centre and I was charged the full $28.00. I want the time credit for the stop.

chat_logs.content: Need to grab food, give me a few minutes.

app_events.details: Rider R-9106 confirmed fixed fare S$28.00.
Driver paused the trip near Toa Payoh. Rider on board. No stop requested by rider.
Driver resumed the trip. DATA ERROR: device clock reset to epoch when this event was logged; server receipt time not retained. The resume time cannot be established from this event.

unrequested_stop_credit_per_min.text: Credit in SGD per full minute that the driver pauses a trip with the rider on board without the rider asking for the stop, after the first 2 minutes. Measured from the driver_paused_trip event to the driver_resumed_trip event. Total credit is capped at 50% of the fare.

refund_at_ryde_discretion.text: Whether Ryde may refund more than the credit above for a stop. False means no refund beyond the credit.

fare_type.text: The fare is fixed at booking and does not change with trip length.

expected_outcome.reason: A per-minute stop credit applies and the pause is clean (driver_paused_trip 21:10:00; the chat shows the driver's own request for a few minutes, so no rider-requested stop), but the driver_resumed_trip event carries an epoch timestamp (1970-01-01T08:00:12) with a logged data error and no retained server time. No other clean record gives the resume moment: GPS shows paused at 21:10 and next on_trip at 21:36:00, a 26-minute window, and the chat has no time. The stop could be anywhere from about 0 to 26 minutes (credit from S$0 up to the S$14.00 cap), so the amount cannot be computed and a person must decide.
